name: tara
description: Analyze the public Tahoe-100M single-cell perturbation atlas (379 drugs x 50 cancer cell lines x 3 doses) through the Tahoe public tools: which drugs, doses and cell lines are covered, gene expression under treatment versus vehicle, drug targets and approval annotations, and how to interpret a served value. Read-only, bounded retrieval with provenance; no SQL, no file access.
